name: 时间工具箱
description: 时间戳与日期互转、时长格式化、日期差计算。按设备本地时区解释，纯本地计算，不联网。
author: Zer0

tools.name: now_time
tools.description: 获取当前时间：Unix 秒/毫秒、本地 ISO 字符串、UTC ISO 字符串、星期与本年周数。适合需要“现在几点”的任务。

tools.name: timestamp_convert
tools.description: 时间戳与日期字符串互转。mode=to_date 把时间戳转成日期（unit 可为 s 或 ms），mode=to_timestamp 把日期字符串转成时间戳。
tools.parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"string","description":"时间戳数字或日期字符串（如 2026-09-19 15:30:00）"},"mode":{"type":"string","description":"to_date / to_timestamp"},"unit":{"type":"string","description":"时间戳单位：s 或 ms，默认 ms"}},"required":["value","mode"]}

tools.name: duration_format
tools.description: 把时长转成人类可读文本（如 1天2小时3分4秒）。输入毫秒或秒，由 unit 指定，默认毫秒。
tools.parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"number","description":"时长数值"},"unit":{"type":"string","description":"ms 毫秒（默认）或 s 秒"}},"required":["value"]}

tools.name: date_diff
tools.description: 计算两个日期/时间戳之间的差值，返回天数、小时、分钟与可读文本。excludeEnd 为 true 时不把结束当天算入整天数。
tools.parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","description":"起始日期或时间戳"},"to":{"type":"string","description":"结束日期或时间戳"},"excludeEnd":{"type":"boolean","description":"是否排除结束当天，默认 false"}},"required":["from","to"]}
